# NorthGo

> NorthGo is a private transport booking platform for the Isiolo ⇄ Nairobi route in Kenya. Passengers book seats on 7-seater Sienta vehicles with verified drivers, live seat availability and favourable fares.

NorthGo offers daily morning and evening departures in both directions. Booking takes about 30 seconds — no app or login required, just a name and phone number. Seats are confirmed instantly and payment is made on board.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Book a seat on the next Isiolo ⇄ Nairobi departure.
- [Trips](/trips): Live list of upcoming departures with seats left, fares and driver details.
- [Drivers](/drivers): Verified NorthGo drivers, vehicles and passenger ratings.
- [Isiolo to Nairobi](/isiolo-to-nairobi): Route information and booking for Isiolo → Nairobi travel.
- [Nairobi to Isiolo](/nairobi-to-isiolo): Route information and booking for Nairobi → Isiolo travel.
- [About](/about): NorthGo's story, services and how the booking process works.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers about fares, luggage, departures, changes and refunds.
- [Contact](/contact): Support options for bookings, complaints, lost items and payment issues.
